attacks.name: Heavy Thrust
attacks.special: A Critical Hit allows the player to re-roll 1 failed Hit.

traits.name: Honour Seeker
traits.description: At the start of their Activation, if an enemy Character is within 4” and neither of them are in Melee Combat, the Hallguard must take a Bravery Test. If this is failed, they must attempt to Charge the enemy Character.
